source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    blocks = []

        for c in range(w - 1):

            tl, tr, bl, br = [grid[rr][cc] for rr,cc in coords]
            colors = (bl, tl, br, tr)
            directions = ((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1))
            for (rr,cc), color, (dr,dc) in zip(coords, colors, directions):
